tile_frame.origin: centre of one printed 170 x 170 mm v4 tile at its bottom plane
tile_frame.y_positive: from the south dock edge into the tactile board

board_interface.mounting_note: Secure all four board-tile holes to a flat table/base first. Then use two longer M6 screws through the two dock U-slots and the south pair at (-75,-75) and (75,-75) mm. The dock feet sit on the same table; the open side of each U-slot must face tile local +Y.

tactip_reference.tool_tcp_assumption: Tool(2) origin is the TacTip compliant contact apex.

reference_pad.purpose: Optional visual-contact / image-change check before executing board sampling.

sampler_transform.note: Teach the seated Tool(2) TCP once after the fixture is bolted down. Keep Joint 6 and the cable exit orientation unchanged across the run.

print.material: PETG preferred; PLA+ is acceptable for calibration-only use.
print.orientation: Print with both narrow feet on the build plate and the locating ring upward.
print.supports: Normally no support. Enable support only for the inside of the locating ring if the slicer flags a bridge.
print.lightweight_design: Two 14 mm feet, two 10 mm solid gussets, and open central space replace a full base plate.

workflow: Bolt the 170 mm v4 tile flat to the table through all four of its M6 holes.
Loosen the two southern screws, slide the dock U-slots in from tile local -Y, then retighten the M6 screws.
Seat the TacTip rigid flange in the ring, with the cable in the outboard slot.
Record the Tool(2) TCP while seated. This becomes the repeatable rest datum for that board setup.
Move vertically out of the dock before moving over a tactile cell; use image-change contact detection at every sampling site.
